criteria.criterion: The agent does not claim it has lost access to data or tools it used moments ago
criteria.reasoning: Nowhere in the conversation does the bot say it has lost access to previous data or tools; it continues to answer order questions consistently.

criteria.criterion: The agent does not make the customer sit through a full re-listing of every order to answer a follow-up about the order they were just discussing
criteria.reasoning: For the follow-up about the shipping address, the bot directly provides the address for the Galaxy Watch order without re-listing any other orders or all order details again.

criteria.criterion: The agent does not re-ask for information already provided (e.g., which order, when the customer already said "Galaxy Watch" and was just discussing it)

scale_metrics_reasoning.coherence: The assistant consistently referred to the same order and details across turns without contradictions or unnecessary re-asking.
